exposure: healthcare professionals' inclination toward ethical values
ethical attitudes toward sexual-reproductive health behaviors and practices
outcome: Inclination to Ethical Values Scale score
Ethical Attitudes Towards Sexual-Reproductive Health Behaviors and Practices Survey score
cohort: The study included 310 healthcare professionals (106 doctors, 108 nurses, and 96 midwives) from a maternity hospital.
finding: Healthcare professionals generally showed high inclination to ethical values and ethical attitudes towards most sexual-reproductive health topics, but less so for abortion, assisted reproductive techniques, prenatal diagnosis, screening, and caesarean section, with gender significantly influencing these attitudes.
mod_finding: Less than half of the participants had ethical attitudes toward caesarean section.
